title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
The Savoy Male and Female College

To Professor J. O. Marberry, an earlier member of my committee, I am grateful for the suggestion of photostat use and arrangements, and to the members of the University photostat department for their care and interest in the production.

I appreciate the time and thought expended in the reading of the thesis by Professors Annie Webb Blanton and W. E. Gettys, the other members of my advisory committee.

For all of the pervading thread of personal and family interest in Savoy College, this thesis doubtless would not have been undertaken but for Professor Frederick Eby and his abiding interest in this chapter in the history of education in Texas. To him I therefore express deep and sincere thanks for his patience, scholarly advice, tolerance, and constructive help, which have made the whole undertaking a pleasant as well as an educational experience.

Mattie Lee Boyd.

The University of Texas
Austin, Texas
June, 1939
notes: Final page of preface. Printed page number IX at bottom.
